"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Today's highly mobile workforce needs portability of insurance coverage that can go with them from job to job.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The need to maintain coverage should not dictate where families have to live and work.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for ending tax discrimination against the individual purchase of insurance.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for repealing the 1945 McCarran-Ferguson Act which protects insurance companies from anti-trust litigation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Look to the growth of Health Savings Accounts and Health Reimbursement Accounts that empower patients and advance choice in healthcare.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Our aging population must have access to safe and affordable care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Because most seniors desire to age at home, we will make homecare a priority in public policy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for implementing programs to protect against elder abuse.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
